dct_title_s: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM)  Drone imagery and GIS package by camp (April 2018)
dct_description_sm: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of April 2018 is based on [NPM Baseline 10](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-bangladesh-round-10-site-assessment) (as of 17 April) and NPM drone imagery (as of 24 April). Here below, the complete package by camp: - SW Map package - KMZ file - Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).
